title: Compliance Manager [IC3]
description:
Who we are

Our mission is to bring clarity and control to the world's most complex codebases. AI is accelerating code creation, but the infrastructure to understand, oversee, and evolve that code hasn't kept pace. Sourcegraph gives engineering organizations full visibility across their systems, precise context for their agents, and the ability to execute coordinated code changes at scale. As agentic development becomes the dominant engineering paradigm, we provide the context layer teams need to take control of their codebase.

With Code Search, Deep Search, MCP, and Agentic Batch Changes, we deliver on that mission today - giving engineering teams and their AI tools the cross-repo context to navigate massive codebases with confidence, and the ability to make changes across hundreds of repositories at once.

Companies like Stripe, Reddit, and Leidos rely on Sourcegraph to ship faster and with higher quality. We're backed by a16z, Sequoia, and Redpoint, and proud to operate as a globally distributed team that values high agency, direct communication, and customer love.

If you want to build the infrastructure that lets every engineering team - and every agent they deploy - operate on their codebase with confidence, join us.

Hours & location
🌎 While we hire almost anywhere in the world, we have a preference for someone to reside in the following locations for this role. However, if you feel qualified, we welcome you to apply regardless of location. No matter what, working hours must overlap with GMT-3 for at least 20 hours/week.
Preferred locations:

• USA
Why this job is exciting
As our Compliance Manager, you will own and drive Sourcegraph ’s governance, risk, and compliance program, with a primary focus on compliance. This is a highly cross-functional role that works closely with Security, Engineering, IT, Legal, People, Sales, and other teams across the company.
You will be responsible for maintaining and evolving our compliance program, including owning certifications such as SOC 2 and ISO 27001 and preparing Sourcegraph for additional frameworks as the business grows. This is not a role where you will simply coordinate work across a large compliance organization. We are looking for someone who has personally owned audit and certification programs end to end: designing and tailoring controls, collecting evidence, training internal teams, working directly with auditors, managing remediation, and driving follow-up work through completion.
📅 Within one month, you will…

• You will build strong working relationships across Security, Engineering, IT, Legal, People, Sales, and other key stakeholders.

• You will develop a clear understanding of Sourcegraph ’s existing governance, risk, and compliance program, including our ISMS, risk register, controls, certifications, audit processes, and current areas of focus.

• You will understand how our SOC 2 and ISO 27001 programs operate today, including key owners, evidence requirements, open risks, and upcoming milestones.

• You will begin participating directly in day-to-day compliance activities and identify opportunities to improve or simplify existing processes.

title: Senior Facilities Operations Technician - Memphis

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Sr. Facilities Operations Technician at SpaceXSI, you'll dive in, operating and maintaining the critical facility systems that power our supercomputing data centers. Working hands-on with MEP systems, you’ll tackle maintenance, operations, and repairs, ensuring peak performance and reliability. Expect to troubleshoot complex issues, streamline processes, and collaborate with teams to keep our infrastructure running smoothly, directly supporting xAI’s mission to accelerate human scientific discovery through AI. 

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Independently operate and maintain critical mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) systems in supercomputing data centers, ensuring high reliability and performance through hands-on maintenance, troubleshooting, and process optimization.

• Perform advanced maintenance and troubleshooting of critical data center systems like HVAC, power, and environmental controls, while mentoring junior technicians to ensure operational reliability.

• Oversee the maintenance and optimization of critical data center infrastructure, including power, cooling, and environmental systems, while leading a team of technicians to ensure operational reliability and efficiency.

• Responsible for MEP Infrastructure site safety and environmental compliance, ensuring the sites align with all local and regional health and safety requirements.

• Provide operational expertise for Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) systems at the datacenter facility. The systems and equipment can include pumps, piping, chillers, cooling towers, CRAH units, wiring, lighting systems, generators, motors, water supply, UPS and switchgear, etc.

• Routinely inspect all areas to ensure performance measures are being maintained and proactively self-report the problems of facilities.

• Experience with writing and executing MOPs, SOPs, EOPs.

• Perform daily inspections of critical systems.

• Identify and maintain spare parts inventory to minimize downtime.

• Coordinate and supervise scheduled system shutdowns.

• Develop and implement energy monitoring metrics.

title: Senior Quality Engineer - Checkout & Payments (m/w/d)
description:
Shopware ist ein führendes E-Commerce-System, das es Unternehmen weltweit ermöglicht, im digitalen Handel schnell und effizient zu skalieren. Als Senior Quality Engineer - Checkout & Payments trägst du dazu bei, zuverlässige Zahlungsabläufe über Shopware, Shopware Payments und externe Systeme hinweg sicherzustellen. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf praxisnahen Integrationstests, Testautomatisierung und Release-Validierung: Du prüfst, ob Kund:innen einen Kauf erfolgreich abschließen können, Bestell- und Zahlungsstatus korrekt sind und Fehler sowie Wiederholungsversuche sicher verarbeitet werden.
Du wirst Teil des Bereichs Quality Operations innerhalb von Delivery Excellence und arbeitest eng mit den Teams Checkout & Payments, dem Produktmanagement und weiteren Quality Engineers zusammen. Du bringst Qualität früh in die Feature-Planung ein, überführst Produktrisiken in ausführbare Tests, untersuchst Fehler und gibst klare Empfehlungen zur Release-Bereitschaft. Die Position ist eine Senior-Engineering-Rolle ohne Führungsverantwortung. Du entwickelst das bestehende Framework für Abnahmetests und die CI-Infrastruktur weiter, statt eine separate Testorganisation aufzubauen.
Requirements

• Risikobasierte Testabdeckung definieren und umsetzen. Arbeite mit Product und Engineering zusammen, um kritische Abläufe für Händler:innen und Kund:innen, die vorhandene Testabdeckung und Lücken zu identifizieren. Stimme für jedes Entwicklungspaket einen klar abgegrenzten Testumfang ab und begleite ihn durch Umsetzung, Review und Validierung.

• Automatisierte Tests entwickeln und pflegen. Nutze TypeScript, Playwright sowie API- und Integrationstests, um das Verhalten im Storefront, in Shopware, im Payments-Service und an den Schnittstellen zu Zahlungsanbietern zu prüfen. Wähle die passende Testebene, statt jede Prüfung in einem Browser-Test abzubilden.

• Zahlungsergebnisse prüfen, nicht nur das UI-Verhalten. Kontrolliere Bestellerstellung, Zahlungsstatus, Beträge und Währungen. Ergänze die Testabdeckung entsprechend dem Produktrisiko um relevante Szenarien zu Stornierung, Einzug, Rückerstattung, Webhooks und Wiederherstellung.

• Integrationsfehler gemeinsam mit Entwickler:innen bewerten. Prüfe bei Bedarf Authentifizierung, Mandantentrennung, wiederholte Anfragen, Idempotenz und asynchrone Statusänderungen. Stelle sicher, dass Fehler weder doppelte Zahlungen noch inkonsistente Bestellungen verursachen.

• Testergebnisse für die Auslieferung nutzbar machen. Integriere und pflege Produkttests gemeinsam mit Engineering und Product Operations in der CI. Verbessere Testdaten, Wiederholbarkeit und Diagnosemöglichkeiten. Unterscheide zwischen Produktfehlern, Problemen bei Zahlungsanbietern oder Umgebungen und instabilen Tests.

• Releases und Kompatibilität validieren. Prüfe relevante Release-Artefakte, Upgrades und unterstützte Konfigurationen im bestehenden Release-Prozess. Überführe Erkenntnisse aus Vorfällen in Regressionstests und konkrete Verbesserungen.

• Eine klare QA-Empfehlung kommunizieren. Erläutere gegenüber Product und Engineering den geprüften Umfang, die Ergebnisse, verbleibende Risiken, Blocker und nächsten Schritte. Sprich Prioritätskonflikte frühzeitig an und begleite offene Punkte bis zu ihrer Lösung, einer vereinbarten Übergabe oder einer klaren Entscheidung.

• Verantwortung und Wissen teilen. Prüfe Testcode, arbeite mit Kolleg:innen im Pairing und verbessere gemeinsam nutzbare Fixtures und Dokumentation. Stimme dich mit anderen Quality Engineers ab, damit die Testabdeckung von mehreren Personen gepflegt und unterstützt werden kann.

Das bringst du mit:

• Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Pflege automatisierter Tests für produktive Software, einschließlich API- und Integrationstests sowie End-to-End-Tests.

• Sehr gute Programmierkenntnisse in TypeScript oder JavaS

Job Overview
We are looking for an Accounts Receivable & Collections Specialist to support an Australian client with growing transaction volumes. In this role, you will manage overdue customer accounts through direct phone and email contact, secure payment commitments, and help reduce outstanding debt. You will work closely with the client's finance team on shared customer accounts and own the month-end credit insurance reporting on overdue accounts.
Key Responsibilities

•
Overdue Account Follow-Up: Confidently contact customers with overdue accounts by phone and email to understand reasons for non-payment and secure payment commitments that reduce outstanding debt.

•
Team Collaboration: Work closely with the client's finance team, who handle routine collections before the due date, to ensure a smooth handover of accounts once they become overdue and consistent communication with customers.

•
Credit Limit Monitoring: Monitor customer balances to ensure agreed credit limits are not breached; run risk assessments, review credit files, and flag high-risk accounts.

•
Doubtful Debt Provision: Calculate doubtful debt provision requirements based on company policy.

•
Month-End Credit Insurance Reporting : Prepare month-end reports on overdue accounts as required by the credit insurance provider.

•
Experience: At least 2 years of proven experience in accounts receivable, credit control, or B2B collections, ideally supporting Australian or other offshore clients.

•
Functional Skill: Strong collections and negotiation skills, with the ability to handle difficult conversations and customer pushback while keeping relationships professional; commercially aware of the cash flow and bad-debt impact of overdue accounts.

•
Tech Skills: Intermediate Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, filters, formatting, and basic formulas). Experience with Creditor Watch or Microsoft Dynamics Business Central is an advantage but not required; training will be provided.

•
Soft Skills: Assertive yet diplomatic, an active listener who can identify the root cause of payment delays and negotiate realistic payment solutions on the spot. Proactive, organized, and collaborative.

•
Language: Excellent spoken English with clear pronunciation, professional phrasing, and the ability to build rapport easily over the phone; strong written English for email correspondence.

•
Education: Bachelor's degree in Accountancy, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred.

• Market-competitive salary

• Health & group life Insurance

• Fixed weekends off; Dayshift schedule

ABOUT THE TEAM

title: Data collector / Driver in Lancaster, CA
description:
Company description
 
Service Measure (SM) is a field data collection company founded in 2013 in New York. 
 
We collect data where automation is not possible. We count features, take pictures, make videos, record speech, and scan areas for every detail you need to make more informed decisions. Our field data collection teams are spread across Europe and North America, ready to accept new challenges.
 
Project objective
 
The goal of the project is to help collect images of streets, main points of interest and public areas in the USA. The project is performed on cars with 360 cameras mounted on top that image the area around the vehicle and store those images on computers inside the vehicle. Later, this data will be used to enhance one the most popular online maps in the world.
 
The data collectors will be given specific routes around public streets and areas, specifically targeting commercial districts and historical sites. Due to poor weather conditions some areas will be visited multiple times in order to collect the best quality of imaging. The project is expected to last from 3 to 6 months and will cover different data collection areas. 
 
The ideal candidate enjoys driving, knows well the area, traffic trends, is highly responsible and reliable.
 
The schedule expected on the project is Monday-Friday, 8 hours/day 40 hours per week. Due to weather downtime, work on weekends is possible.

 
We would be happy to get to know you and your skills better and see how we can support each other's growth.
 
Please apply and let's meet!

Ready to do your best work? Join us.
Working hours: 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time. This is a night shift locally, with full overlap with U.S. clients and the finance team, including during training.

What You'll Do
Own Global AR and Collections

• Availability to work the stated U.S. Eastern Time schedule.

• Familiarity with accounts payable workflows.

• Using AI tools in your work or personal projects, with examples of how they've been useful.

title: Menlo Fellows
description:
The Role
Menlo builds open source and production AI systems, from the brain, to developer facing tools to the runtime infrastructure and humanoid platform underneath. This fellowship is deliberately open ended: tell us your strengths and we'll match you to high impact work across software engineering, systems, applied AI, or research. You'll be hands on from day one, with a Menlo engineer or researcher directly responsible for your mentorship and your results. You own deliverables at the same level as the team you join. We expect you to contribute, not observe.
This is a paid internship program that runs year round. Candidates go through a rigorous interview process and get matched with a senior researcher or engineer working on real world problems.
What You'll Do

• Own a real project end to end, from problem definition through implementation, testing, and documentation.

• Ship production grade work in one or more areas: product engineering, systems, infrastructure, applied AI, or research.

• Work on core Menlo projects, including developer tooling, model runtime and performance, automation, and reliability improvements.

• Debug real issues across codebases and environments, and propose fixes that improve correctness, performance, and maintainability.

• Write clear docs, runbooks, or internal notes that make your work easy for the team to adopt.

• Collaborate closely with engineers and researchers through code reviews and technical discussions.

What We Look For

• University, high school or mid-career individuals looking for a crash course in physical AI and robotics

• The ability to read unfamiliar codebases and make safe, well scoped changes.

• Practical debugging skills: you can isolate problems and validate fixes.

• A grasp of software or hardware engineering basics: testing, version control, and review.

• A high ownership mindset and the ability to work independently with fast feedback loops.

• Above all, we hire for slope: how fast you grow matters more than where you start.

Logistics

• 3 months minimum, based in one of our offices: San Francisco, Ho Chi Minh City, or Singapore

• Paid role.

• Open to pre university and university students.

• You'll need existing work authorization for your office location, as we don't provide visa sponsorship for this role.

Why Join Menlo
You'll do real work that ships, not busywork on the bench. Genuine ownership, direct mentorship from the people building Asimov, and a chance to prove yourself on hard problems alongside some of the most curious and driven people you'll meet. If you want your work to matter beyond a paper or a demo, this is the place.
A Note on AI
You don't need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect everyone at Menlo to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement. When that's the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don't treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.
Equal Opportunity and Accommodations
We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you're excited about a role but don't meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Menlo Research is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Menlo provides reasonable accommodations during the application process. If you need one, please let your recruiter know.

description:
Footprint is the agentic platform that learns your compliance program and runs it end to end.

Compliance teams at banks and fintechs are drowning in financial crimes investigations. Transaction volumes are surging, regulators keep raising the bar, and the work still runs on manual review queues stitched together from legacy vendors. Percy, our agentic system, learns each team's procedures and makes the same calls their analysts would: clearing false positives, escalating real risk, writing the case narrative, and documenting every decision for audit. It cuts review workloads by 70%+.

The harder problem is underneath. Every investigation is grounded in the data sources compliance teams already trust, and every case commits to an organizational memory that compounds - so a pattern one analyst caught in March surfaces automatically in October, across KYC, EDD, sanctions, and monitoring. Whether the team is five analysts or 500, they share one brain. Every memory carries provenance. Agents propose; humans approve. That's four years of identity infrastructure sitting under the agent, and it's the part nobody can bolt on later.

We're backed by QED, Index, and Box Group, and trusted by FDIC- and OCC-regulated banks plus fintechs like Bilt, Nuvei, and MoonPay. We 5x'd revenue last year. The team is small, senior, and ships fast.

The short version: you'll own a book of Footprint customers from the day they sign: working alongside our Forward Deployed Engineers as they get each customer live, meeting with each team regularly and growing what they do with Footprint. This is our first Account Manager, on-site in New York, reporting to Peter Sweeney. Base $145K-$155K, OTE $190K-$205K, plus equity.

 

The Role

We're hiring our first Account Manager to look after Footprint's customers once they sign.

Most customers start with Percy on one workflow and add more over time. When a team you work with wants to add a workflow or a product, you scope it with a Forward Deployed Engineer and close the deal. When a different team or business line at the same customer gets interested, you bring in an Account Executive and work it together.

You'll report directly to Peter Sweeney, our Head of GTM Strategy and Post Sales.

 

What You'll Own

Your book of accounts. You own each customer relationship from signature through every renewal. When an Account Executive brings on a new team at one of your customers, that team joins your book once it signs

From signature to go-live. The Account Executive introduces you once a contract is signed. While a Forward Deployed Engineer gets the customer live, you're their main contact, and once they're live the account is yours

Getting customers what they need. When something comes up, you get the right person at Footprint on it and stay with it until the customer has their answer

Regular check-ins. You meet with each team on a steady rhythm, bring them what's new in the product and hear what's changing on their side. Those conversations are where the next opportunities show up

Growth inside your accounts. Selling new products and new use cases to the teams you manage is yours, and so is making what they already run work harder for them. The opportunity is often a workflow the customer hasn't brought to Footprint yet. You find it, scope it with a Forward Deployed Engineer and close it

The function itself. How we run onboarding, check-ins and the handoff from Account Executives is yours to set

 

Must-Have

- You've owned a book of B2B software accounts after the sale, and you can walk through an upsell you found and closed inside one of them, ideally one where you had to uncover the use case before you could sell it

- You've worked alongside engineers on customer implementations and kept working with them afterward to get customer questions to the right person

The Role
We are looking for an experienced FP&A professional to play a central role in our corporate planning, reporting, and cash forecasting processes. This Manager-level role will bring together the consolidated financial outlook and help ensure Finance has a clear, consistent view of company performance across the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow.
The role will own key corporate FP&A deliverables, including consolidated forecasting, cash flow modeling and forecasting, Board and ELT reporting, PE sponsor and portfolio company reporting, and GAAP-to-non-GAAP bridges.
Our approach to FP&A is simple: understand what happened, determine why it matters, and help the business decide what to do next.
In this role, that means taking inputs from across the FP&A organization and translating them into an accurate, coherent company-level view of performance and outlook. This person will work closely across FP&A, Accounting, Treasury, and the broader Office of the CFO, with significant exposure to senior leadership.
What You’ll Do
Corporate FP&A & consolidation

• Own the consolidation of company forecasts and financial outlooks, bringing together inputs across the FP&A organization into a cohesive company view.

• Ensure consolidated reporting is accurate, internally consistent, and aligned across FP&A and Accounting.

• Strengthen controls, documentation, and repeatability around core FP&A reporting and consolidation processes.

• Maintain and evolve integrated three-statement models, with particular ownership of balance-sheet forecasting and the linkages between operating performance, working capital, cash flow, and ending cash.

• Contribute to the company’s long-range planning process by translating operating assumptions into multi-year P&L, balance-sheet, cashflow, and free-cash-flow outcomes and helping assess longer-term financial trajectory.

• Own the company cash flow forecast and underlying model, connecting P&L performance, working capital, capital expenditures, financing activity, and other cash movements.

• Develop clear bridges between EBITDA, operating cash flow, free cash flow, and changes in cash.

• Partner with Accounting, Treasury, and FP&A business partners to understand collections, payment timing, accruals, deferred revenue, commissions, and other working-capital drivers.

• Identify emerging cash risks and opportunities and incorporate them into the forward outlook.

• Develop scenario and sensitivity analyses around key cash flow assumptions.

• Improve the predictability and transparency of cash generation and the drivers of free cash flow.

Executive, Board & sponsor reporting

• Support periodic reporting to the Board as well as taking a lead role in preparing Board materials and ad hoc analysis

• Coordinate and prepare recurring financial reporting for ELT and the Board, bringing together financial results, forecasts, KPIs, and supporting analysis into a clear and consistent narrative.

• Own recurring PE sponsor and portfolio company reporting requirements and coordinate inputs across Finance.

title: UX Designer - Porting AA UE5 Game to Cloud Streaming (Remote, Americas or Europe
description:
About us:
At Amber, we're always on the hunt for the most talented individuals in the industry to join our team. We're dedicated to delivering top-notch service to our customers and know that our employees are key to making that happen. We offer attractive compensation packages and plenty of chances to grow with us, and we're always on the lookout for ways to do things better. Our team works together towards common goals and we value each member's contributions to our mission of continuous improvement and innovation.
About the role:
Amber is looking for a UX Designer to help bring a high-quality AA Unreal Engine 5 game to a cloud streaming platform. It's a large narrative game, built on one of the most recognized entertainment franchises.
The story and content are locked. Your job is to adapt UX/UI and controls. The goal is a game that's easy to pick up and keeps its pacing. The core direction is only prototyped, and many open problems remain. You'll work alongside UX designers, engineers, tech artists, QAs, and producers. This is a hands-on role: mapping, wireframes, and specs, delivered at volume and largely on your own.
This is a remote contract engagement, expected to run about 2 months, with a possible extension. You'll need to be productive within your first week. Preferred working hours are 7am-4pm Mexico City time. European candidates should overlap with a minimum of 7am-12pm Mexico City time.
What to expect from the process:

• Profile Preselection: Our Talent Acquisition team will review your profile.

• Talent Acquisition Screening: Selected candidates will be contacted to undergo an initial interview to discuss their experience, skills, and fit for the role.

• Test: Qualified candidates will be invited to complete an assessment to demonstrate their abilities.

• Interviews: Finalists will participate in technical and cultural interviews to assess their proficiency and compatibility with our team.

The quest (what you will do):

• Map every interaction in the game to a touch controller.

• Design controller layouts, prompts, and accessibility options in Figma.

• Build onboarding that teaches the controls to players new to games.

• Define system flows, such as settings, pause, and disconnect.

• Write implementation specs for engineering. Run consistency passes across the full game.

• Turn playtest findings into design changes.

• Flag usability risks early. Present options backed by evidence.

The skills (required qualifications):

• At least 5 years as a UX designer in games, with at least one shipped game.

• A portfolio that shows game UX work, such as player flows, wireframes, and interaction specs.

• Proven experience designing touch controls for games.

• Experience designing game UX, preferably for console or TV.

• Onboarding design for casual players.

• Strong Figma skills, including wireframes.

• Working knowledge of game accessibility practices, especially input simplification and alternative controls.

• Comfortable making decisions with incomplete information.

• Clear communication in English, spoken and written.

Nice to have:

• Second-screen or phone-as-controller UX.

• Cloud gaming projects, or input design that holds up under latency.

• Work on narrative or cinematic games.

• Designing to platform requirements, such as console certification rules.

• Motion controls or haptics design.

The Reward:

• A fun and dynamic industry where you can make a difference.

• Professional and friendly work environment.

• Awesome and talented colleagues.

• Support from all your teammates.
